accounts.name: new_admin
docs: The pubkey proposed in `propose_admin`, signing to confirm.

accounts.name: previous_shard
docs: The shard that's currently active (and full).

accounts.name: new_shard
docs: The new shard being allocated; must equal `round.current_shard + 1`.

accounts.name: shard
docs: The shard to close.

accounts.name: rent_recipient
docs: Where the shard's rent goes. Pinned to the program admin so the rent
is reclaimable but no random caller can redirect it.

accounts.name: vrf_request
docs: ORAO's randomness account; we deserialize it manually.

accounts.name: next_round
docs: Optional rollover target — see `resolve_round.rs` for semantics.

instructions.name: donate_to_round
docs: Top up the round's prize pool. The donation goes 100% to the winner
at resolve, on top of the percentages from ticket sales. Anyone may
donate; the lottery must have a pool split (i.e. a Sol-prize lottery).

accounts.name: round
docs: In-flight round; pass `None` when no round is open.

accounts.name: previous_round
docs: The previous round (must be Resolved) — required when `round_index > 1`.
Pass `None` only for round 1.

accounts.name: shard_zero
docs: Header-only allocation; grows via `realloc` on each `buy_tickets`.

accounts.name: round
docs: In-flight round; pass `None` when no round is open.

instructions.name: request_orao_resolution
docs: Public resolution backed by ORAO VRF. Anyone may call this once the
round timer has elapsed (admin may call any time). It CPIs into the
ORAO program to request verifiable randomness — ORAO oracles fulfill
off-chain, then anyone calls `consume_orao_resolution` to draw.

accounts.name: vrf_request
docs: ORAO's randomness account, derived from the seed (= round pubkey).

instructions.name: resolve_round
docs: Admin-driven resolution. Admin supplies a 32-byte seed; the program
derives the winner and distributes splits.

accounts.name: winner_shard
docs: Shard containing the winning ticket. Its `shard_index` must match
what we derive from the seed; otherwise the resolve aborts.

accounts.name: next_round
docs: Optional rollover target — the next Round PDA. Pass alongside
`next_shard` and `system_program` to atomically open round N+1.

accounts.name: next_shard
docs: Optional rollover target — shard 0 for the next round.

accounts.name: round
docs: In-flight round; pass `None` when no round is open.

fields.name: running_total_lamports
docs: Cumulative donations for this round after this event.

types.name: GlobalConfig
docs: Singleton account holding the program's admin authority and VRF wiring.
**PDA seeds:** `[b"config"]`
**Created by:** `initialize_global` (once per deployment).
**Rent payer:** the deployer (becomes the initial admin).

fields.name: admin
docs: The wallet authorized to administer every lottery (create, pause,
disable, etc.). Single-sig today; we assume the user controls it via
a hardware wallet or multisig at the wallet layer.

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Two-step admin handover: when the current admin proposes a new admin,
it lands here. The new admin must call `accept_admin` to take over.
`None` means no transfer in flight.

fields.name: vrf_program
docs: ORAO VRF program id. Varies between localnet/devnet/mainnet, so we
store it on-chain rather than hardcoding it.

fields.name: vrf_treasury
docs: ORAO treasury account used to pay fulfillment fees.

fields.name: next_lottery_id
docs: Monotonically increasing counter; the next created Lottery uses this
as its `id` (and as a seed for its PDA).

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump for `[b"config"]`. Stored to avoid recomputing on every CPI.

types.name: Lottery
docs: A configurable lottery. One Lottery has at most one active Round at a time.
**PDA seeds:** `[b"lottery", id.to_le_bytes()]`
**Created by:** `create_lottery` (admin).
**Rent payer:** admin. Reclaimed on `close_lottery` once Disabled.

fields.name: id
docs: Stable id, assigned from `GlobalConfig.next_lottery_id`. Used as a
PDA seed so we don't need a global lookup table.

fields.name: name
docs: Human label, ASCII, zero-padded.

fields.name: ticket_price_lamports
docs: Price per ticket. Editable any time; the change applies to the NEXT
round only (each Round snapshots its price on open).

fields.name: round_duration_seconds
docs: Round duration in seconds (e.g. 86_400 for 24h). Same edit semantics.

fields.name: auto_rollover
docs: If true, `resolve_round` immediately opens round N+1.

fields.name: splits
docs: Revenue splits for new rounds. Edited via `update_splits`. The current
round's snapshot is what governs payouts for that round.

fields.name: current_round_index
docs: `0` until the first `open_round`; thereafter the index of the
most-recently-opened round.

fields.name: total_rounds_resolved
docs: Lifetime counter incremented in `resolve_round`.

fields.name: total_tickets_sold
docs: Lifetime counter incremented on every successful `buy_tickets`.

fields.name: field
docs: ASCII tag for which field changed: "price", "duration", "splits".

types.name: LotteryState
docs: Lifecycle of a lottery configuration.
```text
Active  <->  Paused
v       v
PendingDisable  --(current round resolves)-->  Disabled
* **Active**: rounds can run, tickets sell.
* **Paused**: no sales; the in-flight round's timer freezes.
* **PendingDisable**: in-flight round will finish; no new round opens after.
* **Disabled**: terminal. The Lottery PDA may be closed by the admin to
reclaim rent.

fields.name: num_received
docs: Total number of received requests.

fields.name: mint
docs: ORAO token mint address.

fields.name: treasury
docs: ORAO token treasury account.

fields.name: fee
docs: Fee in ORAO SPL token smallest units.

types.name: PrizeKind
docs: What kind of prize a lottery awards.
* **Sol** — winner is paid SOL out of the round's pool split.
* **Physical** — off-chain prize delivery. The contract still picks and
records a winner pubkey, but pays them no SOL. The full ticket revenue
is split among the configured (non-pool) destinations.

types.name: Round
docs: One in-flight or historical lottery round.
**PDA seeds:** `[b"round", lottery.key(), index.to_le_bytes()]`
**Created by:** `open_round`.
**Rent payer:** the caller of `open_round` (admin always for round 1;
admin or anyone with `auto_rollover` enabled for subsequent rounds).
The Round PDA also holds the SOL escrow for ticket sales:
`buy_tickets` `system::transfer`s lamports onto this account; on resolve
the program drains them back out via direct lamport mutation (allowed
because the program owns the Round account). The rent-exempt minimum is
preserved across all transitions.

fields.name: lottery
docs: The Lottery this round belongs to.

fields.name: index
docs: 1-based index within its Lottery.

fields.name: started_at
docs: Unix seconds at which `open_round` ran.

fields.name: duration_seconds
docs: Snapshot of `Lottery.round_duration_seconds` at open time.

fields.name: ticket_price_lamports
docs: Snapshot of `Lottery.ticket_price_lamports` at open time.

fields.name: splits
docs: Snapshot of `Lottery.splits` at open time. Frozen for the life of the
round so mid-round config edits never affect existing buyers.

fields.name: paused_at
docs: `Some(timestamp)` while the round is paused; `None` otherwise.

fields.name: paused_total_seconds
docs: Total seconds the round has been paused for, accumulated across
pause/resume cycles. Used to extend `effective_end`.

fields.name: tickets_sold
docs: Lifetime ticket count for this round.

fields.name: donated_lamports
docs: Cumulative SOL donated to this round's prize pool via `donate_to_round`.
Added on top of the `is_pool` split's share at resolve.

fields.name: current_shard
docs: Index of the active TicketShard PDA receiving new ticket writes.
Advanced by `allocate_shard` when the previous shard fills.

fields.name: max_shard
docs: Highest shard index ever allocated for this round (== `current_shard`
when no rollover has happened, otherwise greater). Used by
`close_shard` to know how many shards exist after resolve.

fields.name: winner
docs: Set on resolution. `None` for empty rounds (zero tickets).

fields.name: vrf_request
docs: VRF request PDA while in `AwaitingVrf`; cleared after resolve.

fields.name: winner
docs: `None` for empty rounds (zero tickets).

fields.name: winning_ticket_index
docs: `None` for empty rounds.

fields.name: pool_amount_lamports
docs: Lamports paid to the winner (0 if no pool split or empty round).

fields.name: total_distributed_lamports
docs: Sum of every transfer made by `resolve_round`.

types.name: RoundState
docs: Round-level lifecycle.
```text
Open  --(timer expires OR admin force)--> Closed
Closed --(request_resolution)--> AwaitingVrf
AwaitingVrf --(consume_resolution)--> Resolved
`Resolved` is terminal. There is no cancel/refund path: ticket sales
are non-refundable by design.

types.name: Split
docs: One slice of ticket-sale revenue.
Per-collection rules (validated on `create_lottery` / `update_splits`):
* 1 ≤ `splits.len()` ≤ 8.
* Each `bps` is a multiple of 100 (1% increments only).
* `PrizeKind::Sol` ⇒ exactly one Split has `is_pool == true`.
* `PrizeKind::Physical` ⇒ no Split has `is_pool == true`.

fields.name: label
docs: Human label, ASCII, zero-padded. Used by UIs; not interpreted on-chain.

fields.name: destination
docs: Destination wallet for this slice. Ignored for `is_pool` splits — the
pool is paid to the round's winner (computed at resolve time).

fields.name: bps
docs: Basis points of the round's gross sales. `100 bps == 1%`.
Constrained to multiples of 100.

fields.name: is_pool
docs: Marks the prize-pool slice. At most one per Lottery.

fields.name: running_total
docs: Cumulative ticket count for the round after this purchase.

types.name: TicketShard
docs: One page of the round's ticket book.
We shard tickets across multiple PDAs because:
1. Solana account allocation is bounded per instruction.
2. Capping shard size simplifies error recovery and reasoning about gas.
**PDA seeds:** `[b"shard", round.key(), shard_index.to_le_bytes()]`
**Created by:** the first `buy_tickets` that needs a fresh shard.
**Rent payer:** that buyer.
Drawing math:
`winner_index = randomness % round.tickets_sold`
`shard_index  = winner_index / CAPACITY`
`offset       = winner_index % CAPACITY`
→ read `shard_index`'s `buyers[offset]`.

fields.name: round
docs: The round this shard belongs to.

fields.name: shard_index
docs: 0-based index of this shard within the round.

fields.name: len
docs: Number of tickets currently stored. Always ≤ `CAPACITY`.

fields.name: buyers
docs: Buyers, indexed by ticket number within the shard. Pre-allocated to
`CAPACITY` so individual buys never have to realloc.

types.name: VrfRequest
docs: One VRF request bridging `request_resolution` to `vrf_callback`.
The request lifecycle:
1. `request_resolution` creates this PDA, sets `seed`, leaves
`fulfilled = false`.
2. ORAO's fulfillment quorum invokes `vrf_callback` (signed by ORAO's
callback authority); we write the 64-byte randomness and flip
`fulfilled = true`.
3. The same callback (or `force_resolve` after a timeout) reads
`randomness` and resolves the round.
**PDA seeds:** `[b"vrf", round.key()]`
**Created by:** `request_resolution`.
**Rent payer:** the resolver (admin or cron caller).

fields.name: round
docs: The round this request fulfills.

fields.name: seed
docs: Seed sent to ORAO. Must be unique per request to avoid collisions
(we use the round's pubkey + slot at request time).

fields.name: fulfilled
docs: Set to true once `vrf_callback` writes the randomness.

fields.name: randomness
docs: 64-byte VRF output. Only the first 8 bytes are used to derive the
winner index; the rest is stored for auditability.

fields.name: requested_at
docs: Unix-seconds time of the request, used by `force_resolve` to enforce
the 1-hour timeout.
